step3_testbench.description: Testbench to characterize the single NMOS transistor, measuring DC drain current, threshold voltage, and AC gain with a 1k load.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Single NMOS Characterization Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 NET3 NET2 NET4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}

* Voltage Sources and Load
VVDD VDD 0 DC 1.8
VVCONTROL NET2 0 DC 0.9 AC 1
RLOAD VDD NET3 1k
VN4 NET4 0 DC 0

.control
  * 1. Operating Point for DC Current
  op
  let id_current = i(VVDD)
  print id_current

  * 2. DC Sweep for Threshold Voltage
  dc VVCONTROL 0 1.8 0.01
  * Find Vth at a small constant current (e.g., 1uA)
  meas dc vth_meas find v(NET2) when i(VVDD)=1u
  print vth_meas

  * 3. AC Analysis for Voltage Gain
  ac dec 10 1 1Meg
  let gain_db = vdb(NET3)
  meas ac midband_gain_db find gain_db at=1k
  print midband_gain_db

  quit
.endc
.end
